headline: Donate To Climate
hero.description: Let your intent turn into genuine climate action. Back young entrepreneurs, fund climate tech, and sponsor projects bringing direct impact to nature.

pathways.name: Smriti Van Forest Plantation
pathways.story: Initiate a forest plantation drive in the memory of a loved one. The Manisha Smriti Van project eternalises the memory of a dear one, giving birth to trees and forests that bring fresh life and natural beauty to the city ecosystem.

pathways.name: Fund Climate Accelerators and Startup Cohorts
pathways.story: Donate to MEF's flagship accelerators — LowCarbon.Earth, SAFFAL, or any other — and boost the development of climate technology that cuts down emissions and builds low-carbon, nature-friendly solutions. Funding goes to pre-vetted top performers of the cohort as grants or credits.

pathways.name: Contribute To Original Research & Pilot Projects
pathways.story: MEF engages with the hottest sectors in climate — Air Pollution, Electric Mobility, Plastic, Waste Management, and others — to procure fresh insights, detailed data, and the market understanding essential to grasp the state of a sector, gauge investment scope, and manage risk. Each report relies on ground-level data coupled with global datasets to produce reliable knowledge systems.

pathways.name: Build Livable Cities
pathways.story: From Delhi's air to Agra's waste streams, MEF's city projects attack the problems urban India breathes and walks through every day — air pollution, broken waste systems, heat islands, and streets never designed for people.
resolves_into: Air pollution study and intervention work
City waste system audits and fixes
EV rickshaw transitions — cleaner air and better livelihoods

pathways.name: Teach Climate
pathways.story: MEF's education programmes build climate literacy where it compounds — in classrooms, and in the professionals whose decisions shape emissions. Environmental education, ESG training, and governance capacity, delivered where it changes behaviour.
resolves_into: A generation that doesn't need convincing

pathways.name: Where It's Needed Most
pathways.tagline: Trust the foundation to route it
pathways.story: Some donors prefer to delegate the decision. The general fund lets MEF direct your support to the sharpest current need across all programmes — the gap a restricted gift can't reach. It is the simplest address, and often the most powerful one.
resolves_into: Rapid response when a project hits a critical moment
The unglamorous costs that make everything else work

proof.partners_line: Built on partnerships with UNEP, GIZ, IFC, UN Women, Invest India, Google Cloud, Microsoft for Startups and more.

form.trust_note: Massive Earth Foundation is a Section 8 non-profit registered in India with 12A, 80G and FCRA certifications — Indian donors receive 80G tax receipts, and foreign contributions are received in full legal compliance. All receipt and compliance details are shared personally when we contact you about your pledge.
